brief_provenance_receipt.note: whitespace tokens are a LOWER BOUND on model tokens; this receipt reports both, per call, so the bound can be seen to hold

cap_sweep.rule: the sweep estimates a cap's envelope as (the brief's own tokenized halves) + (the fixed per-request overhead measured in the whole-brief pass). Tokenization is not exactly additive across the two '\n\n' joins, so this is a NARROWING step only: the chosen cap and the next larger candidate are both re-rendered in full below, and the decision is made on those exact numbers

comparator_envelope.note: the direct baseline's constant 62-token envelope is the floor this cell's brief is added on top of; the difference is the price of the brief, in tokens, on the flight tokenizer

decision.why_identically: the two fragments differ in exactly one key, evidence_source. A cap set on one and not the other would make KU-E1c a second treatment instead of a form control, and the cell's whole claim -- that a gain surviving the twin is knowledge rather than prompt shape -- would be void. The composed configs are re-checked for a single differing key before any measurement is taken
decision.why_largest_not_smallest: the preregistration asks for 'the smallest brief_max_entries_per_class that fits'. Read literally that is degenerate: the fit is MONOTONE in the cap, so cap 1 always fits and would be chosen every time. The intent is the smallest INTERVENTION -- the largest cap whose worst request still fits, i.e. the least of the brief that has to be thrown away. That is what is chosen here, and the next larger candidate is measured too so the choice is proved at the boundary from both sides

not_certified_here: VRAM, throughput and the flight's own go/no-go. This receipt certifies only that the protocol's largest request fits the declared slot and what the brief costs in tokens. It is not an authorization to fly: KC-E1 needs its own exposure row and the owner's own GO

speech_token_rule.provenance: the mmproj encoder's one-second window rule certified by docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-04-e21-full44-direct-baseline-v1/window-fit/window-fit.json, which reproduced all 342 sealed COST records of SAEA-E-005B-N10-zero at this exact protocol

what_this_is: precondition 2 of the v2 preregistration: the pre-meeting brief and both cells' complete requests measured on the FLIGHT tokenizer, for every one of the 1,593 fixed 90-second windows the flight would contact, at zero generated tokens

wire_shape_summary.why_here_and_not_in_the_wire_check: core.model.transport.LlamaServerTransport re-runs the full I5 session liveness, pinned-binary and socket-ownership check on every send, so the REAL transport can only be driven beside a REAL resident server. The contact-free wire check therefore proves everything up to and including the payload, from the sealed trace; this block proves what the transport does with that payload, on the same requests the fit measures

media_stand_in.why: the media is a single opaque marker in the rendered prompt, so the audio bytes cannot move a text count. Sending the real 90-second slices would deliver 39.3 hours of call audio to the core for a measurement that reads none of it; their token cost enters through the one-second window rule instead, per window, from their durations
